name: stri_trans_isnfkd
title: Test whether strings are in NFKD

origin.description: Report whether each string is already in NFKD.
origin.details: TRUE when the string is already in NFKD. Capital omega is TRUE. The ohm sign is FALSE because it decomposes. An empty string is TRUE. A missing value stays missing.
origin.value: A logical vector of the same length as str.
origin.example:
cat(paste0("stri_trans_isnfkd of the ohm sign returns ", stri_trans_isnfkd("Ω"), ".
"))

translation.description: Report whether each string is already in NFKD.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list or tuple of those.

translation.details: unicodedata.is_normalized with NFKD matches this test. An empty string is True. NA stays NA.
translation.value: True or False, or a list of those values when str is a list or tuple.
translation.example:
from stringi.normalize import stri_trans_isnfkd
print(f"stri_trans_isnfkd of the ohm sign returns {stri_trans_isnfkd('Ω')}.")
